title: DashboardPlanPreview owns plan-preview page navigation, not the mutation client
answers: Where does navigating to /dashboard/new for a plan preview, or returning to the previous page on dismiss, happen?
How does Grafana Assistant preview a dashboard plan without being on a dashboard page?
Why does RENDER_PLAN work even when no dashboard is currently mounted?
body: DashboardPlanPreview (public/app/features/plugins/components/restrictedGrafanaApis/dashboardMutation/DashboardPlanPreview.ts) is the single process-wide owner of plan-preview navigation: it navigates to /dashboard/new, polls for the newly mounted DashboardMutationClient, remembers the origin page, and on END_PLANNING with restoreUserLocation returns there via locationService.replace — all before any command reaches the dashboard scene. dashboardMutationApi.execute routes RENDER_PLAN/END_PLANNING to this coordinator first (public/app/features/plugins/components/restrictedGrafanaApis/dashboardMutation/dashboardMutationApi.ts), falling back to currentClient() for other mutations. It tracks client deactivation via onClientDeactivated to avoid restoring/acting on a stale session when a newer preview or manual navigation has superseded it. Future work on preview navigation, multi-preview races, or 'stay on dashboard vs return' behavior belongs here, not in renderPlan.ts/endPlanning.ts.
applies: Dashboard plan preview navigation triggered through the restricted Grafana Mutation API
